assets.name: compass
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent 3D illustration for SYNAQ, an educational website for children ages 9–13 and their parents. Premium playful product render, sculptural rounded forms, tactile satin plastic with some glossy details, vivid cobalt blue and turquoise with small sunny yellow and coral accents. Soft studio light from upper left, clean occlusion, high detail, joyful but polished, no characters, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no backdrop or floor, true alpha transparency. Square composition, whole scene fully visible, generous 12% clear margin. Three-quarter orthographic view. Subject: a bold cobalt blue navigation compass with a cream dial and a bright coral needle pointing toward a small floating turquoise destination pin. Compass tilted upright, a short curving turquoise path curls around its base, two small yellow stepping stones. One clear coherent scene that means find your starting point. Oversized compass, few elements, readable at 180px.
